summary: A low-cost, spacious flower-and-garden outing on Bangkok’s eastern edge, with seasonal displays, plant stalls and food. Current Time Out and Kapook listings both give 1–10 December 2026, but a direct organiser announcement for 2026 was not independently verified. Worth shortlisting for garden lovers and photographers; allow for the journey from central Bangkok.
whyGo: Large flower beds and the distinctive Ratchamongkol pavilion make a colourful photography walk.
Combine ornamental gardens with plant-market browsing and casual Thai food rather than another indoor attraction.
A relaxed outdoor option when your itinerary needs a slower morning.
bestFor: Families happy with a substantial park walk
skipIf: You have very little Bangkok time and are staying far across town
You dislike extensive outdoor walking or heat
You want a guaranteed headline performance or fireworks show
duration: Allow 2–3 hours inside as a planning estimate, plus travel; longer for markets and performances.
cost: 2026 media listings: THB 20 admission per person and THB 50 car parking; reconfirm before visiting. Food and transport extra. Ordinary park admission is listed by BMA as THB 10, which is distinct from festival pricing.
hours: 2026 listings give 05:00–19:00 daily during 1–10 December; individual stalls and performances may operate shorter hours.
bestTime: Early morning for softer light and a more comfortable walk. Evening is popular; do not assume all gardens remain accessible after the advertised closing time.
gettingThere: MRT Yellow Line to Suan Luang Rama IX, then continue by taxi or local transport to the chosen park gate. The station name does not mean an entrance is immediately outside. Free electric shuttles from Paradise Park and Seacon Square operated in 2025; 2026 service is unconfirmed.
booking: A 2026 advance-booking requirement was not established. Treat as a walk-up outing, then check the organiser’s latest entrance and ticket arrangements before departure.
accessibility: Large grounds mean substantial distances. Step-free routes, accessible toilets, mobility hire and festival-specific surfaces were not verified; ask the organiser before relying on wheelchair access throughout.
practicalTips: Bring drinking water, sun protection and comfortable footwear.
Choose a gate after checking the festival map; different entrances serve different zones.
Keep the first visit flexible rather than booking transport around an unconfirmed performance.
decemberNotes: 1–10 December 2026 is supported by two current media listings, rather than inferred solely from earlier years. The 2025 official festival ran on those dates. Fireworks and exact 2026 flower varieties are not confirmed; preparation can affect November park access.
uncertainties: No directly verified 2026 organiser programme or final map.
2026 shuttle timetable, fireworks and performance schedule remain unverified.
Photos show earlier editions and do not promise the same 2026 displays.
